name: MosaicView
description: MosaicView - Desktop manager for digital comics, with a mosaic grid view for fast page-level editing (reorder, crop, rotate, convert...). Supports CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF, and EPUB. Built-in support for fictional-language readers (Klingon, Sindarin, Quenya). Releases can be found here : https://github.com/Bruno-Aublet/MosaicView/releases

paragraphs: MosaicView is a Windows desktop application for preparing, organizing, and processing image collections, with a particular focus on digital comics (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF).

Its visual mosaic workspace lets you work directly with the pages contained in comic archives and other image-based documents: organize them, edit them, convert them, extract or assemble pages, manage metadata, and process multiple files at once. No manual extraction required.
MosaicView is not a comic reading app. It is a tool for easily managing your digital comic files, with an integrated viewer to inspect and edit their pages.
features: Mosaic view — browse all pages of an archive at a glance, as thumbnails
Undo / Redo — every operation is reversible
Reorder pages — drag and drop pages into the right order directly in the mosaic
Rename pages — edit filenames inline, without extracting anything
Delete pages — remove unwanted pages in one click

requirements.text: A free ComicVine API key is required.
